name: Badge
summary: A small count or status marker — notification counts, unread dots, status colour.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-badge> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `count` renders a number (capped by `max` as N+), `dot` renders a bare status dot, and `status` sets the colour. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: count
props.desc: The number shown in the bubble

props.name: max
props.desc: Cap; above it renders as max+

props.name: dot
props.desc: Render a bare status dot, no number

whenToUse.when: a count or status attached to another element (a bell, a tab, an avatar)
a standalone label/keyword chip with text

opinion.note: A badge marks another element — anchor it to one. Keep counts meaningful; cap large numbers with max so the bubble stays small.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
